date_note: Livecoins' page, published 26 November, reports the CEO's statement and gives no earlier disclosure day; the CEO says probing attempts were detected on 23 November.

evidence.quote: Em 23 de novembro, detectamos tentativas de sondar nossa plataforma.

exec: Livecoins reports Zodia Custody confirmed that business contact names and email addresses of a small part of its clients and employees were leaked.
geo_basis: no location stated in the page read
plain: Livecoins reports crypto custodian Zodia Custody, a Standard Chartered subsidiary, confirmed a client data leak. Business contact names and email addresses of a small part of clients and employees were exposed.

sources.name: Livecoins: Standard Chartered's crypto custody firm confirms client data leak

summary: Livecoins reports that Zodia Custody, a Standard Chartered subsidiary, confirmed a client data breach and took its B2B API offline as a precaution. Zodia's CEO Richard Clark said in a statement on X that on 23 November it detected attempts to probe its platform. According to Livecoins, a small part of clients and employees had business contact names and email addresses leaked; no number was given.
title: Zodia Custody, Standard Chartered's crypto custody arm, confirms leak of client business contact data, Livecoins reports

validation.note: Only Livecoins was read; the Portal do Bitcoin article and the CEO's X post were not read. A search found no English-language report.

review.note: Compared title, 23 Nov probing quote, API offline, no count, single source against Livecoins
